description: This file defines the IdentityCryptFilter class which implements a crypt filter that passes data unchanged in the PDFSharp library's security module. It provides singleton access and overrides encryption and decryption methods to perform no operation.
external_files: // base class for crypt filters (assumed to be located elsewhere in the project)

classes.name: IdentityCryptFilter
classes.description: Represents an identity crypt filter that passes data unchanged in the PDF security processing of the PDFSharp library.

methods.name: EncryptForEnteredObject
methods.description: Overrides the base method to perform no encryption, returning true to indicate data is unchanged.

methods.name: DecryptForEnteredObject
methods.description: Overrides the base method to perform no decryption, returning true to indicate data is unchanged.
